headline: Nigeria Deposits Instrument of Ratification to Join African Medicines Agency
summary: Nigeria deposited its instrument of ratification of the African Medicines Agency Treaty, officially becoming the 34th member state of the regulatory body.
why: The African Medicines Agency harmonizes medical product regulation across African Union member states, impacting pharmaceutical trade, drug safety standards, and regional market access.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Ratification integrates Nigeria into a continental regulatory framework for pharmaceutical manufacturing.
